transcript.en: Hello, Easy Life Cleaning Services, Jacinta speaking.
transcript.zh: 你好，这里是Easy Life清洁服务，我是Jacinta。

transcript.en: Oh hello. I'm looking for a cleaning service for my apartment - do you do domestic cleaning?
transcript.zh: 你好。我想给我的公寓找一家清洁服务公司 你们可以做家庭清洁吗？

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 当然可以。

transcript.en: Well, it's just a one-bedroom flat. Do you have a basic cleaning package?
transcript.zh: 嗯，只是一套一居室的公寓。你们有基本的清洁服务套餐吗？

transcript.en: Yes. For a one-bedroom flat we're probably looking at about two hours for a clean.
transcript.zh: 有的。对于一居室的公寓来说，我们可能需要两个小时才能打扫干净。

transcript.en: So we'd do a thorough clean of all surfaces in each room, and polish them where necessary. Does your apartment have carpets?
transcript.zh: 我们会彻底清洁每个房间的所有地面，如果需要的话会对其进行抛光。你的公寓有地毯吗？

transcript.en: No, I don't have any, but the floor would need cleaning.
transcript.zh: 我没有地毯，但地板需要清洁。

transcript.en: Of course  we'd do that in every room. And we'd do a thorough clean of the kitchen and bathroom.
transcript.zh: 当然，每个房间我们都会这样清洁打扫的。并且会彻底打扫厨房和浴室。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Then we have some additional services which you can request if you want - so for example, we can clean your oven for you every week.
transcript.zh: 另外如果您愿意的话，我们还可以提供一些额外的服务例如，我们可以每周为您清洁烤箱。

transcript.en: Actually, I hardly ever use that, but can you do the fridge?
transcript.zh: 事实上，我几乎不太使用烤箱，但你们会清理冰箱吗？

transcript.en: Sure. Would you like that done every week?
transcript.zh: 当然。你希望每周都清理吗？

transcript.en: Yes, definitely. And would ironing clothes be an additional service you can do?
transcript.zh: 是的，当然。熨烫衣服也包含在你们的额外服务之内吗？

transcript.en: Yes, of course.
transcript.zh: 是的，当然。

transcript.en: It wouldn't be much, just my shirts for work that week.
transcript.zh: 需要熨烫的不会太多，只有我那周上班穿的衬衫。

transcript.en: That's fine. And we could also clean your microwave if you want.
transcript.zh: 没问题。如果你愿意的话，我们也可以清理你的微波炉。

transcript.en: No, I wipe that out pretty regularly so there's no need for that.
transcript.zh: 不用了，我会经常擦拭的，所以不需要你们来处理。

transcript.en: We also offer additional services that you might want a bit less often, say every month. So for example, if the inside of your windows need cleaning, we could do that.
transcript.zh: 我们还提供您可能不太会经常需要的额外服务，比如说每月的频率。例如，如果你的窗户内部需要清洁，我们可以来进行处理。

transcript.en: Yes, that'd be good.
transcript.zh: 好的，那太棒了。

transcript.en: I'm on the fifteenth floor, so the outside gets done regularlyby specialists, but the inside does get a bit grubby.
transcript.zh: 我住在十五楼，所以窗户外面经常由专门人员来清理，但里面确实有点脏。

transcript.en: And we could arrange for your curtains to get cleaned if necessary.
transcript.zh: 如有必要，我们可以为您安排窗帘清洗。

transcript.en: No, they're OK. But would you be able to do something about the balcony? It's quite small and I don't use it much, but it could do with a wash every month or so.
transcript.zh: 不用了，窗帘不需要。但是你们可以处理一下阳台吗？它很小，并且我不怎么用，大约每个月洗一次就可以了。

transcript.en: Yes, we can get the pressure washer onto that.
transcript.zh: 没问题，我们可以用压力清洗装置来处理。

transcript.en: Now if you're interested, we do offer some other possibilities to do with general maintenance.
transcript.zh: 如果您有兴趣，我们也可以提供一些其他的日常维修方案。

transcript.en: For example, if you have a problem with water and you need a plumber in a hurry, we can put you in touch with a reliable one who can come out straightaway.
transcript.zh: 例如，如果你有水管方面的问题，而且需要一个水管工的话，我们可以帮你联系一个可靠的，可以立刻赶过来的维修人员。

transcript.en: And the same thing if you need an electrician.
transcript.zh: 如果你需要电工的话，也是一样如此。

transcript.en: Right. That's good to know. I've only just moved here so I don't have any of those sorts of contacts.
transcript.zh: 好的，听起来不错。我刚搬到这里，所以我没有任何维修人员的联系方式。

transcript.en: And I don't know if this is of interest to you,  but we also offer a special vacuum cleaning system which can improve the indoor air quality of your home by capturing up to 99% of all the dust in the air.
transcript.zh: 我不知道您是否对此感兴趣 但我们还提供一种特殊的真空吸尘系统，它可以通过捕获空气中99%的灰尘来改善您家的室内空气质量。

transcript.en: So if you're troubled by allergies, this can make a big difference.
transcript.zh: 所以，如果你有过敏症的困扰，这项服务会让您看到明显改变。

transcript.en: Right. In fact, I don't have that sort of problem, but I'll bear it in mind. Now can you tell me a bit about your cleaning staff?
transcript.zh: 好的。事实上，我没有这方面的问题，但我会记住的。现在你能给我介绍一下你们的清洁人员吗？

transcript.en: Of course. So all our cleaners are very carefully selected.
transcript.zh: 当然。我们所有的清洁工都是经过精心挑选的。

transcript.en: When they apply to us, they have to undergo a security check with the police to make sure they don't have any sort of criminal background,
transcript.zh: 当提出申请加入时，他们必须接受警方的全面背景信息检查，以确保他们没有任何犯罪记录

transcript.en: and, of course, they have to provide references as well.
transcript.zh: 当然，他们同时还必须提供推荐信。

transcript.en: Then if we think they might be suitable for the job, we give them training for it. That lasts for two weeks so its very thorough, and at the end of it, they have a test.
transcript.zh: 然后，如果我们认为他们适合这份工作，我们会对其进行培训。培训持续两周，所以会非常的全面，并在结束的时候安排他们进行测试。

transcript.en: If they pass that, we take them on, but we monitor them very carefully - we ask all our clients to complete a review of their performance after every visit and to email it to us.
transcript.zh: 如果通过了，我们会录用他们，但我们也会非常仔细地监督他们 我们会让所有客户在每次服务后完成对其绩效的评估，并通过电子邮件发送给我们。

transcript.en: So we can pick up any problems straightaway and deal with them.
transcript.zh: 因此，我们可以立即发现任何问题并加以解决。

transcript.en: OK, well that all sounds good. And will I always have the same cleaner?
transcript.zh: 好的，听起来不错。我会一直使用同一位清洁人员吗？

transcript.en: Yes, we do our best to organise it that way, and we usually manage it.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们尽最大努力这样安排，并且我们通常都能做到这一点。

transcript.en: Good. That's fine. Right, so I'd like to go ahead and ...
transcript.zh: 好的。非常棒，所以我想继续了解...
